title: Remote viewers spy on Saddam Hussein
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Remote viewers spy on Saddam Hussein, about 1990-1991 at Iraq, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: like the remote viewers for example who were tasked to psychically spy on Saddam Hussein during the first Gulf War, Lin Buchanan and others, they actually went into Saddam's mind to the extent that
We knew exactly who he was. We turned it in every day. They knew where he was.
tellings.difference: Buchanan tells it firsthand and says they reported Saddam's location every day.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the Gulf War remote viewers tasked to spy on Saddam Hussein, Buchanan among them.

as_told.title: Remote viewing Saddam Hussein every day
